reuse.why: Reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold so the tolerance is the same one matching uses, and keeps getScheduledAmount for the base value.

duplication.why: No copied block; only a small inline sign-times-threshold adjustment that the shared amount helper could own.

placement.why: The tree resolves a schedule amount to its expected value in getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts), where the ranged worst case lives, but the approximate worst case is added inline in the budget template's createScheduleList.

scope.why: Only the template adjustment and its tests.

maintainability.why: The worst-case rule is now split: ranges in getScheduledAmount, approximate amounts only in schedule-template.ts, so other planning consumers such as the forecast's normalizeSchedule keep the exact value and must be patched separately.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList adjusts the amount after getScheduledAmount instead of teaching the shared amount resolver about 'isapprox'.

disguised_duplication.where: Nothing duplicated; the tolerance comes from the shared getApproxNumberThreshold.

one_place.where: The approximate worst case is applied only in createScheduleList (server/budget/schedule-template.ts); the amount rule's shared definition getScheduledAmount and its other planning users (e.g. forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule) do not apply it.
